name: ffc-server
description: Backend API for the mini-golf scorecard PWA (Free For Cart / FFC).

scripts._comment_test: Concurrency scales with the box: node --test defaults to availableParallelism()-1 (3 workers on a 4-core dev machine), but these tests are dominated by Postgres round trips and process startup rather than CPU, so they idle. Measured on 4 cores, 710 tests: 58.0s at the default, 35.3s at 8, 30.6s at 12, 31.9s at 16 — so ~3x cores, capped, and never below the old default. Peak node RSS was ~1.8GB at 12, which is why this is derived from the machine rather than pinned: the deploy gate runs this suite on a droplet. Override with TEST_CONCURRENCY; if the substitution itself fails the || falls back to 8, because this script is the deploy gate and must not break on an odd host.
scripts.test: node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test --test-concurrency=$(node -p "process.env.TEST_CONCURRENCY || Math.max(3, Math.min(16, ((require('node:os').availableParallelism ? require('node:os').availableParallelism() : require('node:os').cpus().length) * 3)))" || echo 8)
